content.title: It's Pie Time: National Pi Day Food Freebies and Deals
content.text: March 14 is National Pi Day — a time to celebrate that well-known mathematical constant 3.14 (the ratio of a circle’s circumference to its diameter, if you need to brush up on your math skills). And what better way to celebrate than with pie (both savory and sweet). Here are 15 satisfying pie and pizza pie deals to cure any craving. Burger King Burger King’s Royal Perks rewards members can get a free Hershey’s Sundae Pie or Cinnamon Apple Pie with any $3.14 purchase. Redeem this offer in the BK App or by visiting BK.com. Find a Burger King near you. Marco’s Pizza Marco’s Pizza customers who buy any large or extra-large pizza can get a medium one-topping pizza for $3.14 on March 14. Use the promo code PIDAY on the Marco’s website, or mention it while ordering over the phone, to get the deal. Locate your nearest Marco’s Pizza. Sheetz Sheetz customers can get a cheese or pepperoni pizza flatz for $3.14 from March 14 through March 20. Just make sure you add the offer under the OFFERZ tab of the Sheetz app to redeem. Check out a Sheetz near you. Papa Murphy’s Online or in-app orders from Papa Murphy’s will be 31.4 percent off on March 14 when you use the promo code PIDAY26 at checkout. See where you can find your closest Papa Murphy’s. 7-Eleven, Speedway and Speedy Café 7Rewards and Speedy Rewards members can get any whole pizza for $3.14 in stores — and through the 7NOW Delivery app — on March 13 and 14. Speedy Rewards members who order from a Speedy Café can also get a large one-topping pizza for $3.14. In addition, anyone who visits 7-Eleven or a 7-Eleven adjacent store that sells 7-Select Snack Pies can get these hand pies for $1 from now through April 28, with no code or rewards membership required. Check out the 7-Eleven locations and the Speedway locations to see what’s in your neighborhood. Uno Pizzeria & Grill Order a regular-priced deep dish or thin crust pizza from Uno Pizzeria & Grill on Pi Day and get a second one of equal or lesser value for $3.14. Just mention this deal to your server in the restaurant or use the promo code BOGO314 at online checkout to get the deal Find your local Uno’s. Round Table Pizza Check out the Round Table Pizza Royal Rewards app on Pi Day to get a one-topping personal pizza for $3.14 when you purchase any large or extra-large pizza. This offer is good for dine-in, carryout and delivery orders. See if there’s a Round Table Pizza near you. Blaze Pizza Visit a Blaze Pizza in person on March 14 to get an 11-inch pizza for $3.14 when you buy one of equal or greater value. Rewards members who make a purchase on Pi Day will also get a coupon in the Blaze Pizza app for a buy one, get one free 11-inch pizza, to use at a later date. Locate your closest Blaze Pizza. Most Popular MOD Pizza MOD Pizza has a couple of ways to score on Pi Day. The first 314 people who use the promo code IRRATIONAL during checkout will each get one MOD-size pizza for $3.14. But MOD rewards members who don’t get lucky in this regard can still get $3.14 off their purchase of a MOD-size pizza on March 14 by redeeming this reward in the MOD Pizza app. Find your nearest MOD Pizza. Village Inn Village Inn customers can get a slice of pie for the discounted price of $3.14 on March 14 – no codes needed. Check out Village Inn locations. Laredo Taco Company Visit a Laredo Taco Company to get a quesadilla for $3.14 on Pi Day – no code or rewards membership required. Laredo Taco Company outlets are located in select 7-Eleven, Stripes and Speedway stores. Find a Laredo Taco Company close to you. Raise the Roost Chicken & Biscuits Get an apple or cherry Cinnamon Sugar Fried Pie for 31.4 cents at Raise the Roost on March 14. No code or rewards membership is needed for the deal. Raise the Roost locations are in select 7-Eleven stores and Speedy Cafés. Find your local Raise the Roost. Instacart Instacart is partnering with Red Baron for Pi Day. Simply add an eligible Red Baron pizza to your cart on the delivery service’s app or website to get the pie for free. Spend at least $10 to be eligible for delivery. This deal is valid on March 14. Check out the Instacart website for this deal. DoorDash The DoorDash delivery app has a few Pi Day deals up for grabs: Pizza Hut: Get a free medium or large “create your own” pizza when you buy one on March 14. Sbarro: Get $4 off any order of $20 or more from March 14 through April 6. Blaze Pizza: Get a free 11-inch cheese pizza when you buy one from March 14 through April 6. No codes are needed for any of the above deals. Head to the DoorDash X Pizza Hut page, the DoorDash X Sbarro page or the DoorDash X Blaze Pizza page to get your order(s) started. Gopuff Delivery service Gopuff is offering 25 percent off Edwards Frozen Hershey’s Chocolate Cream Pie Slices and Edwards Frozen Key Lime Pie Slices on March 14. These discounts automatically apply at checkout when you make a qualifying purchase. Visit the Gopuff website. Abigail Seaberg is a freelance journalist based in San Diego. She covers subjects as diverse as oncology research, local news, celebrity updates, and health and wellness topics.
